Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.persistence.mapper

Class AgentMapper

java.lang.Object
com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.AgentMapper
public final class AgentMapper extends Object
Translates between the Agent domain aggregate and the four JPA entities that back it (AgentJpa plus the three side-row entities).

Pure Java — no Spring stereotypes. The AgentRepositoryAdapter is the single caller. toAgentJpa(Agent, com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.persistence.entity.UserJpa) needs a UserJpa reference for the parent FK; the adapter obtains one via UserJpaRepository.getReferenceById so we never trigger an extra SELECT just to satisfy the association.
